scope: Exact three shared concepts, twelve grammatical forms and twelve one-way outward non-distractor relations only; no installation/target/round/quality approval.

node_definitions.sense: Physical hardware hinge, not figurative bodily joints.
node_definitions.rationale: Physical support/guidance and moving-door/window applications are independently evidenced. Description is consistent with those mechanics.

node_definitions.sense: Wood material for construction/household objects; ordinary tree-derived material, not firewood-piece counts or a named plant.
node_definitions.rationale: Ministry teaching directly links furniture wood to trees and examines its material structure. The chosen material sense is conservative; no plural piece aliases are adopted.

node_definitions.sense: Physical slider-operated closure, not an abstract/software zipper.
node_definitions.rationale: Maker explains opposing meshing element rows and slider motion; actual clothing/bag applications support the defined physical mechanism.

claims.caption: permite rotirea unei uși batante
claims.rationale: Physical door-leaf opening and hinge role support rotation of a swinging room/entrance door; sliding/hingeless doors are outside the asserted case.

claims.caption: poate permite rotirea canatului mobil al unei ferestre
claims.rationale: Maker tilt-and-turn system has moving window-leaf hinges; possible mobile-sash rotation is precise and does not describe fixed panes.

claims.caption: se poate monta la ușile batante ale unui dulap
claims.rationale: Maker installs moving furniture doors on named hinge types; qualified swinging cabinet-door application is honest.

claims.caption: unele balamale se fixează cu șuruburi
claims.rationale: IKEA directly lists hinge fixing as a wood-screw application and Roto depicts screw mounting. Some glass interfaces use adhesive; the some-hinges qualification correctly preserves that counterexample.

claims.caption: material provenit din părțile lemnoase ale unui copac
claims.rationale: Official teaching explicitly states furniture wood comes from forest trees; the material origin direction is wood-to-tree, with no inferred reverse arc.

claims.caption: poate fi folosit la fabricarea unor scaune
claims.rationale: Maker chair material is solid pine, a specific example sufficient for some-chairs wording. Metal/plastic/chair-frame alternatives are not denied.

claims.caption: piesele de lemn se pot îmbina cu șuruburi pentru lemn
claims.rationale: IKEA directly lists joining wood materials; Bosch distinguishes the suitable wood screws. Caption does not imply all screw types work for all materials.

claims.caption: se poate tăia cu fierăstrăul
claims.rationale: Original Bosch manual directly discusses saw cuts in wood. Some saws/blades are material-specific; possibility wording avoids universality.

claims.caption: poate fi folosit la închiderea pantalonilor
claims.rationale: Original maker brochure and official teaching each identify zipper closures in trousers; button/elastic trousers remain possible.

claims.caption: poate fi folosit la închiderea unei fuste
claims.rationale: Original maker brochure and official teaching each identify zipper closures in skirts; other skirt closures remain possible.

claims.caption: poate fi folosit la închiderea unei geci
claims.rationale: Own-brand Romanian jacket has a central zipper; no claim every coat/jacket has a zipper.

claims.caption: poate fi folosit la închiderea compartimentelor unui ghiozdan
claims.rationale: Manufacturer schoolbag collection and model specify zip-fastening pockets; current Romanian SKU additionally confirms primary-school ghiozdan compartments. Qualified schoolbag closure is supported with maker evidence, not just a generic outdoor bag.
